concerns.text: Task T004 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but its implementation writes to a shared checkpoint file (`data/checkpoints/sim_checkpoint.json`) and a single results CSV (`results/simulation_results.csv`). Parallel executions would race on these artifacts, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T005 aggregates error‑rate metrics from `results/simulation_results.csv` into `results/aggregate_error_rate.csv`. If run in parallel with other tasks that also write to the same CSV, it could cause write‑conflicts; the `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.
Task T006 generates plots based on CSVs produced by T005 and T006 itself writes PNG files. Parallel runs could overwrite the same plot files, making the `[P]` designation inaccurate.
